issue_context.title: Fast-path source generator not honoring `JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull` for `Nullable<T>` properties.
comments:
I can confirm this is a bug of the fast-path generator which doesn't apply the `WhenWritingNull` condition for properties of type `Nullable<T>`. This appears to be a regression from .NET 7 and we should try to service it. As a temporary workaround you can disable fast-path like so:

```C#
[JsonSourceGenerationOptions(DefaultIgnoreCondition = JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull, GenerationMode = JsonSourceGenerationMode.Metadata)]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(MyPoco))]
public partial class ForecastSerializationContext : JsonSerializerContext
{ }
```

review_comments: The root cause of the issue is that only the generic type definition of `Nullable<T>` is reported as `SpecialType.System_Nullable_T` resulting in the `CanBeNull` property in line 36 of this file to report incorrect values.
